name: Ewha Womans University
summary: Women-only Seoul university; Scranton College's Division of International Studies teaches its major courses in English to international applicants.

ib.text: Women applicants only. The guide names no IB score. For International Studies, proof of English (TOEFL iBT 80, IELTS 6.0 or New TEPS 326) or a school curriculum taught entirely in English is needed.

apply.via: Ewha online application, originals by post after offer

programmes.name: International Studies
programmes.about: An interdisciplinary programme combining economics, political science, business, history and law around global issues. All courses are taught in English in small classes, with optional certificate tracks such as International Business and Economics.
programmes.ib: English proof is required (TOEFL iBT 80, IELTS 6.0, New TEPS 326, or an English-taught school); the Korean-language step other freshmen take does not apply.
programmes.selectionNote: Document review of academic record, language, major preparation and motivation; an interview only if asked. No quota. Spring 2027 guide shown.

programmes.name: Global Korean Studies
programmes.about: Korean studies from a global perspective in Scranton College, set up in 2015, leading to a Bachelor of Arts in Global Korean Studies. The admissions guide says all major courses are taught in English.
programmes.ib: English proof is required (TOEFL iBT 80, IELTS 6.0, New TEPS 326, or an English-taught school); the Korean-language step other freshmen take does not apply.
programmes.selectionNote: Document review of academic record, language, major preparation and motivation; an interview only if asked. No quota. Spring 2027 guide shown.

notes: Ewha accepts women only; applicants and both parents must hold no Korean nationality, and dual Korean nationality makes you ineligible.

Most freshmen spend a first year in the Global Scholars Program (Korean language and general education), but the Division of International Studies is exempt and also exempt from the TOPIK level 4 graduation requirement.
Fall 2027 dates are not published; the Spring 2027 round ran 2 September to 8 October 2026 and the Fall 2026 round ran 4 March to 3 April 2026.
